english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a physical way out, including a road or motorway exit.

examples.english: The exit ahead is the one off the expressway.
examples.traditional: 前面個出口就係落高速公路嘅。
examples.jyutping: cin4 min6 go3 ceot1 hau2 zau6 hai6 lok6 gou1 cuk1 gung1 lou6 ge3

english.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for the act of exporting.

examples.english: Export has been doing well this year.
examples.jyutping: gam1 nin4 ceot1 hau2 zou6 dak1 gei2 hou2
